en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a museum-style display case filled with religious and ceremonial silver objects. At the top center is an ornate crucifix with Christ on the cross; to its left are long tongs or compasses arranged in a star shape around a circular medallion, and to the right are two measuring or carpenter's tools crossed in an X. The middle shelf holds several detailed silver figurines and vessels, including small statues of robed figures and a man in historic dress, plus richly decorated cups. The bottom has a large reflective vessel or ciborium-like object standing upright and, along the lower shelf, several small cups, a teapot, and possibly a rosary or chain. The photograph is framed with a generous white border typical of early 20th‑century postcards; in the lower right corner of the image a small code "H3310Ba" is printed.
